title: A step nothing can satisfy: the failure names what it waited for and the run still stops everything
notes: This scenario is meant to fail. It proves the failure contract: the message names the pattern and the
file, a screenshot of the failing step is taken, and the client, the server, the guard, the capture and
the scratch databases are all still stopped and dropped.
